text: 小朋友们,大家好。我是来自上海市实验小学的曹老师。You can call me 曹老师。我叫曹老师。我是实验小学的曹老师。You can call me Ms.Nice to meet you.Today, we are going to learn module 2, unit 2, food I like.Are you ready?First, let's enjoy a rhyme.Here we go.Apple pie, banana pie.Pizza and cake, pizza and cake.Hamburger, hamburger, hamburger, hamburger.Soup, soup.Look, there are some snacks on the table.Sweets and apple pie.Hamburger.Ice cream.Biscuits.Cakes.And jelly.It's tea time.Oh, who's there?It's Tom.Mom, I'm home.Would you like some snacks?Great.Tom comes home.妈妈会给他吃些什么小食呢?Which snacks does Tom like?Tom喜欢吃什么小食呢?Let's watch and find out.Do you like biscuits?Here you are.Thank you, mom.Do you like sweets?No, mom.I like jelly and ice cream.Thank you.Taste the jelly, mom.Nice.Thank you, Tom.Maybe sweets.Or jelly.Which snacks does he like?He likes biscuits, jelly and ice cream.Look, some biscuits.Do they smell nice?One biscuit, two biscuits.Smell the biscuits.A biscuit.Tom takes one biscuit and smells it.Wow, nice.Look, this is a biscuit.Follow me.Biscuit.Listen carefully.Please read after me.Mom takes two biscuits.I can see.Nice, nice, nice.Could you read after Tom?Now, could you be Tom?What nice biscuits?Mom takes these nice biscuits.And she asks,Do you like biscuits?Tom likes these nice biscuits.And he says,Yes.This time, please follow them.What does mom ask?Please follow mom.And Tom says,Yes.Mom gives Tom these nice biscuits.Now, let's read in rows.Boys, could you be Tom?And girls, could you be mom?Tom takes these biscuits.Wow, here are some sweets.How many sweets?One, two, three.Three sweets.One blue sweet.One yellow sweet.And one red sweet.Sweet.Now, please read after me.These sweets look nice.Does Tom like these sweets?Does Tom like sweets?No, Tom doesn't like sweets.Mom asks,Do you like sweets?And Tom says,No, mom.This time, I will be mom.Could you be Tom?This time, I will be Tom.Could you try to be mom?Tom likes biscuits, but he doesn't like sweets.What else does he like?What else does Tom like?Tom says,I like jelly and ice cream.Look, this is jelly.Now, follow me.Jelly.Tom likes jelly and ice cream.I like ice cream.Cold and sweet.I like jelly.Nice and yummy.Let's sing the song.Wow, jelly is nice and yummy.Ice cream is cold and sweet.He says,I like jelly and ice cream.Let's sing after Tom.Mom gives Tom jelly and ice cream.Tom has biscuits, jelly, and ice-cream.Tom would say something to mom.小朋友们,请你们想一想。这时Tom会对妈妈说什么呢?Do you like jelly, mom?Oh, that's a good question.Maybe Tom would like to share the nice jelly with mom.What does Tom say?Tom, you are a good boy.Mom, taste the jelly.Jelly is sweet.Mom is so happy.小朋友们,让我们再来看一遍对话。这次跟着Tom和妈妈一起来读一读吧。I like jelly and ice-cream.小朋友们,和爸爸妈妈一起分享美食的时光一定是很美好的。Boys and girls, you really did a good job today.See you next time.Bye bye.
